name: scd-flutter
description: Dart 3.x and Flutter 3.44+, in seven skills with disjoint activation scopes: one developer question should load exactly one of them. dart-idioms (language and stdlib, valid in any Dart project including pure CLI/server/package), flutter-architecture (official MVVM guide, layer rules, state mechanism by scope, platform targeting, desktop packaging), flutter-runtime (reconciliation and Keys, layout contract and intrinsics, dropping below the widget, hot reload, frame budget, Impeller-era diagnostics, memory lifetime, isolates, uncaught-error observability), flutter-testing (test layers, fakes vs mocks, goldens, fakeAsync, driving an interaction, the accessibility harness, flakiness and coverage), flutter-data (HTTP clients, retry and cancellation, tokens and sessions, serialisation, local databases, offline-first), flutter-ui-interaction (animations, gesture arena, focus and shortcuts, pointer input from hover to right-click, text input, Material 3 theming, accessibility, i18n), flutter-build-release (flavors, Android/iOS signing, versioning, pubspec constraints and monorepos, pub.dev publishing, CI/CD, release size). Sourced from docs.flutter.dev, dart.dev and pub.dev, with official prescription separated from practitioner practice and undocumented areas named rather than filled by inference.
